# Fixture provenance

The original-execution observations in original-numeric-raster.txt,
original-formations.txt, original-chains.txt, original-combat.txt,
original-frame-prelude.txt, original-frontend.txt and original-text.txt were
captured from the 2002-08-09 Standard PC executable, SHA256:

`342c06e95886fb610071d9b511a52fa0eb64e2307ac6767d146a63e286a0782a`

They contain numeric outputs, normalized snapshots or raster hashes, not machine
code. Captured routines used controlled setup and platform-only sound substitutions;
they establish the recorded mechanism projections, not full original-session
identity. Observation headers describe inputs/fields shared by fixture readers;
production mechanisms do not supply their own expected outputs. The extraction
harness is maintained separately. Normal builds consume the accepted fixtures
without an original executable or reverse-engineering tools.

original-aof-hst.txt is an original Arse on Fire save-format sample, not an execution
trace. stage-session-input.txt and frontend-session-input.txt are native ordinary-input
recordings used for connected stage/session regression checks. Their expected state
comes from the port's saved regression boundary, not independent original execution.

Saved image and generic-raster comparisons elsewhere in the tests check renderer
consistency and optimizations. They are distinct from the captured-original data.
